title: Moving In The Right Direction
summary:
Venezuela's production and exports are recovering
On January 3 rd of this year, Venezuelan president Maduro and his wife were captured by U.S. special forces in a predawn raid and flown to the United States to face criminal charges. Delcy Rodriguez, Maduro's former Vice President and Oil Minister, was officially sworn in as the interim president of Venezuela on January 5, 2026.
